name: JARVIS-CI-Local
description: Local n8n replacement for paid GitHub Actions. Every 30 minutes it calls the JARVIS CI bridge (scripts/ci_bridge_server.py, a localhost wrapper around scripts/ci_bridge.py) which lists open PRs, gates each merge result in a local shadow worktree via scripts/ci_gate.py, and publishes one commit status per gate context. n8n v2 removed the Execute Command node, so local commands run through the bridge over HTTP instead. Edit the Config node to choose how many PRs to gate and whether statuses are published.

nodes.name: Schedule every 30 min
nodes.notes: Automatic poll every 30 minutes. Activate the workflow to enable this trigger.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Click the editor's Run button to gate on demand.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit limit / dryRun / pr in this node's code.

nodes.name: Run Local CI (bridge)
nodes.notes: POSTs to the localhost CI bridge, which runs scripts/ci_bridge.py. Bound to 127.0.0.1 and token-authenticated.

nodes.name: Fail If Not OK
nodes.notes: Turns the execution red when the bridge reported ok:false.
